titleJa: 塩化ビニル（資料の掲載例）
altJa: 芯に巻かれた透明なフィルムと、その手前へ広がる一続きの薄いシートのイラスト。巻いた層と、広げた部分の縁やしわが見えます。
observationJa: 資料で塩化ビニルとして示された例に対応するイラストです。巻いた部分と広げた部分を分け、透明な面、重なった層、縁の形を観察します。
limitJa: 外観を学ぶための例で、透明さや色、巻いた形だけでは塩化ビニルとポリエチレンなどの樹脂を識別できません。この図から厚さ、耐紫外線性、保温性・耐熱性、燃焼性や安全性能を判断せず、燃やすなどの識別試験や使用手順も示しません。

provenance.prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Original gentle botanical-style 2D material illustration for a Japanese agriculture learning app: one complete roll of clear transparent agricultural covering film with a plain beige cardboard tube core visible at one end. A short broad edge of the same clear film is unfurled forward in a gentle soft curve, visibly connected to the roll; the roll and its full transparent loose edge are entirely inside generous margins. Independent oblique composition, warm ivory neutral background visible through the transparent film, restrained pale gray-blue edge highlights and soft subtle folds to make the clear material readable. Refined hand-painted educational 2D style consistent with warm-ivory vegetable and material illustrations, soft natural shading and minimal contact shadow. Film must look thin and flexible, not glass, not a rigid sheet, not bubble wrap, not mesh or fabric. No machinery, greenhouse structure, hands, flames, tools, packaging, material labels, markings, text, numbers, logos, arrows or watermark. No claim that transparency identifies a polymer: the art is a generic example associated with a source caption, not proof of PVC versus polyethylene, thickness, UV resistance, thermal/fire properties or safety performance. Entirely new arrangement; no PDF or reference photograph supplied.
